title: Choose the plugin site's world
question: The roll assigned the Seed Packet Rack. Keep it, take my pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Seed Packet Rack
options.lineage: hardware-store seed racks and packet printing (and Minecraft's seeds)
options.thesis: Every plugin is a seed packet: small, labelled, planted on your server in a minute.
materials: printed packet stock in each plugin's accent
options.viewport: The rack: the pitch on the rack's header card, the eleven packets standing in category rows, each front showing its glyph, name, tagline and contents, with Download on every packet.
options.risk: Reads twee or garden-centre if the packets are pastel or the type is soft; it has to stay Minecraft (seeds, world seeds) and stay serious.

raised.raise: One unbroken version thread: a plugin's releases run as a single line from first sowing to today.
Switches that light: each packet back lists its features as a row of switches, lit when on by default, because everything is switchable.
Catalogue numbers: every packet carries a printed lot number, and the rack index is the map.
Stamped tallies: jar size, Minecraft range and Folia set as measured stamps, never as adjectives.

options.label: Inventory and Item Tooltip
options.lineage: Minecraft's chest inventory and item tooltips
options.thesis: The family as a chest inventory: hover a slot and read the plugin's tooltip.
options.viewport: A chest inventory owns the first screen: every plugin a slot; the hovered plugin's tooltip shows its name in its accent, its lore and its stats, with Download.
options.risk: The most literal reading, and where most runs for a Minecraft product land: it can tip into gamer cliché.

options.label: Convention Hall Catalogue
options.lineage: doujin event catalogues: a numbered thumbnail grid keyed to a hall map
options.thesis: The catalogue and the map are one space: every plugin a numbered cell on a hall plan of categories.
materials: pen circles for what you picked
options.viewport: A hall plan of the four categories, every plugin a coded cell, circled in its accent when chosen.
options.case: Holds on clarity: a coded grid keyed to a map browses eleven plugins fast; owners don't identify with the convention hall.
options.risk: Density can read as a spreadsheet if the cells lose their glyphs.

options.label: Bulletin Board Nightboard
options.lineage: dial-up BBS title screens and numbered menus
options.thesis: The site as a text screen with numbered exits: each plugin a menu line, each page a screen.
options.viewport: Block-character XENA title art over numbered menu lines, one per plugin.
options.case: Holds on identification: owners live in a server console; loses on clarity for first-time visitors.
options.risk: Retro novelty that hides the offer from someone who just wants the jar.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: One object's life as a continuous ribbon of custody.
options.viewport: A ribbon-led column through dated folds.
options.case: Loses both axes: archival custody isn't how owners think about plugins.
options.kept: One continuous line carrying a plugin's versions.
options.risk: Solemn and slow for a download page.

options.label: Rhythm Machine Step Row
options.thesis: A row of lit step keys under a chase light.
options.viewport: Sixteen step keys under a tempo readout.
options.case: Loses both axes: a sequencer says nothing about plugins.
options.kept: Features as lit switches, on by default.

options.label: Catalogue Sleeve
options.thesis: Every artifact a catalogue number on matte black.
options.viewport: One coded number owning a black field.
options.case: Loses both axes: codes in place of names hurt a first-time owner.
options.kept: Strict catalogue numbering with an index as the map.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Weather cut into blocks and stacked.
options.viewport: A cut cloud cliff with tally boards.
options.case: Loses both axes: dreamlike where owners want plain facts.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A modern project hub like Modrinth or PaperMC's site, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and actions over a grid of plugin cards, then docs.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every plugin site, which is what you asked to avoid.
